svg.aria-label: ChatGPT serving: prompts from paid, free and batch lanes wait in a queue and are admitted into free slots of a GPU's running batch; every step adds one token to every reply in the batch, a finished reply frees its slot at once and the next prompt takes it, and the tokens stream out to people's screens

svg.text: SQ-14 · CHATGPT · ONE TOKEN PER STEP
THE BATCH IS REBUILT EVERY STEP · STOPPING A REPLY FREES ITS MEMORY
